AgentWorkflowResumeRequest.description:
Continue a workflow paused at `approval_required` once an approver has approved (ADR-0012, ADR-0014).

The paused step is resubmitted unchanged with the approval: it runs as a new governed run, policy is
evaluated again (approval never overrides a deny) and a budget approval lifts the cap once. The
remaining steps of the definition then continue under the same workflow budget.

BudgetIn.description:
A cap on one scope (LLD §12). `scope_id: default` is a template applying to every scope of its type
without its own budget (e.g. each user, each workflow). Periods: daily/monthly for tenant, department,
application, user, model and gpu_pool; `request` for request (a per-request ceiling; scope_id is an
application ID or default); `workflow` for workflow (scope_id `<application_id>/<workflow_id>` or
default). GPU-pool budgets cap estimated GPU cost; `public_demo` (scope_id: the tenant, daily or monthly)
caps public visitors' live runs, API plus estimated GPU cost (ADR-0019); `internet_gpu` (scope_id: the
tenant, daily or monthly) caps the estimated GPU cost of internet key calls' live runs (ADR-0027); all
others cap API spend.

alert_thresholds.description: Fractions of the cap that raise an alert once per period; the hard cap is implicit.

direct_frontier.description: FinOps' direct-frontier estimate of the same requests (`cost.direct_frontier_estimated_micros`): the full original context and the served answer at the frontier's list price; a cache hit avoids the frontier cost of the answer it reused. Never better than estimated.

hosting_excluded.description: Estimated local GPU hosting of the in-house models (CIM and sovereign) in the window, not in `aiva`, as on /live. The savings waterfall's net includes it, with ledger corrections, so its net savings differ from `saved` by these.

direct_frontier_estimated_micros.description: What this request would have cost sent straight to the pinned frontier model with no AiVa optimization: the full original context (on the served attempt's metered token basis, as the savings waterfall's frontier baseline) and the served answer's output tokens, at the frontier's list price with no cache discount. On a cache hit, the frontier price of the reused answer. Arithmetic only: no call is made, on any path. Null when no answer was produced. The measured comparison is `baseline_micros`.
